subject: 429 errors on Pro plan
customer_question: I've been getting CF-429 errors constantly since Monday. I'm on the Pro plan and using version 4.1 of CloudFlow. What's going on?
resolution: The issue was due to peak usage exceeding the Pro plan's limit of 600 requests per minute. We advised adding exponential backoff using the Retry-After header and staggering the scheduled jobs. Once they were adjusted, the errors stopped.
